review_evidence: README identifies Vero as a work-in-progress programming language intended to generate zkSNARKs of executions.

A complete scan of all 23 Lean files found 118 declaration-style lines. Vero/Core/Reduction/Direct.lean defines normal forms plus strict and non-strict evaluation/application/quotation/instantiation and reduction for the core expression language.

The remaining core/frontend/pipeline modules define syntax, typing/inference, encodings and staged translations. These constitute reusable programming-language semantics/formal-interface prior art despite the absence of theorem declarations in this revision.
summary: Reviewed Vero and retain its formal syntax, type-inference and operational reduction machinery for the Vero language.
